items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: East Coast Titans: Yusef, Frank, James,

ctx.x: Listen please! I am reminded of this uniqueness when I listen to The Sorcerer, or else I’ll think of Sombrero Sam which I connected with Memphis. Groove music. And the number of your other works for flute... It is significant that all of Buddy’s students came up with very different approaches to the instrument, and that my generation was so fortunate to have you, Eric, and Buddy as models, along with the East Coast Titans: Yusef, Frank, James, as well as the Southern master Hubert Laws. Who did you listen to on…
